import pytest
from datetime import date
from late_fee_calculator import LateFeeCalculator  # adjust import path, module name guess


def make_calc(today):
    return LateFeeCalculator(today=today)


class TestWeekdayDaysBetween:
    def test_end_before_start_zero(self):
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 1))
        assert calc._weekday_days_between(date(2024, 1, 10), date(2024, 1, 5)) == 0

    def test_end_equal_start_zero(self):
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 1))
        d = date(2024, 1, 5)
        assert calc._weekday_days_between(d, d) == 0

    def test_skips_weekend_days(self):
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 1))
        # Fri Jan 5 -> Mon Jan 8: only Fri counts, Sat/Sun skipped
        assert calc._weekday_days_between(date(2024, 1, 5), date(2024, 1, 8)) == 1

    def test_full_week_counts_five(self):
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 1))
        # Mon Jan 1 -> Mon Jan 8, one full week -> 5 weekdays
        assert calc._weekday_days_between(date(2024, 1, 1), date(2024, 1, 8)) == 5


class TestComputeFeeCents:
    def test_balance_zero_gives_zero_fee(self):
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 20))
        assert calc.compute_fee_cents(0, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 0

    def test_balance_negative_gives_zero_fee(self):
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 20))
        assert calc.compute_fee_cents(-500, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 0

    def test_today_before_due_date_gives_zero(self):
        # end <= start branch inside helper, then billable_days negative
        calc = make_calc(date(2023, 12, 20))
        assert calc.compute_fee_cents(100000, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 0

    def test_within_grace_period_gives_zero(self):
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 8))  # few weekdays past due, under 10
        assert calc.compute_fee_cents(100000, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 0

    def test_exactly_at_grace_boundary_gives_zero(self):
        # days_past_due == 10 exactly -> billable_days == 0
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 13))
        assert calc.compute_fee_cents(100000, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 0

    def test_normal_fee_calculation(self):
        # billable_days == 5, balance big enough to avoid min/max clamps
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 20))
        fee = calc.compute_fee_cents(1_000_000, date(2024, 1, 1))
        assert fee == 2500

    def test_minimum_fee_applied(self):
        # tiny balance, billable_days == 1 -> raw fee under $5 min
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 16))
        fee = calc.compute_fee_cents(10_000, date(2024, 1, 1))
        assert fee == 500

    def test_maximum_fee_capped(self):
        # huge time gap forces cap at 25% of balance
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 1))
        balance = 100_000
        fee = calc.compute_fee_cents(balance, date(2020, 1, 1))
        assert fee == int(balance * 0.25)

    def test_round_half_up_not_banker_rounding(self):
        # raw_fee lands on x.5, must round up not to-even
        calc = make_calc(date(2024, 1, 16))
        fee = calc.compute_fee_cents(1_049_000, date(2024, 1, 1))
        assert fee == 525
